whether the current account still matches
The interaction still waits for the follow-up sync and library refresh;
it does not return as soon as the credentials are committed.
Cancellation or connection changes after the commit do not undo the imported credentials.
whether another device's latest record still offers the account
revoke by default; keep only when sync and login sync are on
and the account is offered elsewhere
bump bootstrap generation, clear local snapshot, apply signed-out state
profile change → merged login / playback publication request
request /logout with the cookies from before sign-out
success or thrown error; never touches a newer local login
Cookies in the sync folder are sealed with a key derived from the sync passphrase;
the key lives only in each device's Keychain.
The server session is revoked by default and kept only while another device
still offers the account; the last device out revokes it.
With sync off, nothing is withdrawn from the cloud until it reconnects.
